summary_en: 600,000 shares (11.8% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥200M, acquisition window 23 June 2026 – 18 June 2027, open-market purchase on Nagoya Exchange via discretionary intermediary method. Purpose: capital-efficiency improvement and shareholder return.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Gaiaックス resolved at today's board meeting to acquire up to 600,000 treasury shares (11.8% of the 5,102,710 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 31 December 2025) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥200M. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Nagoya Securities Exchange using a discretionary intermediary arrangement (取引一任方式) between 23 June 2026 and 18 June 2027. The stated rationale is capital-efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns. No price ceiling per share is disclosed in the filing.
